estimates.assumptions: Peanut cookies assumed similar to peanut butter cookies or shortbread with peanuts; typical calorie density around 480 kcal/100g for such baked goods. Used supplied measurement of 175g directly as edible mass.
Standard gelatine leaf is ~1.7g each; 5 leaves total ~8.5g edible. Calories based on typical dry gelatin at ~340 kcal/100g. Modest amount as it's a setting agent.
Golden syrup density ~1.4 g/ml but used supplied 175g measurement directly as the edible mass. Typical calorie density for golden syrup is ~320 kcal/100g.

Measurement is 'crushed' with no quantity; modest sprinkling amount of 50g assumed for topping the finished cheesecake (realistic for scattering on a 20cm cake to serve 8-10). Used the supplied knownCaloriesPer100g of 486 exactly.
